en.headline: 6 own commits plus 10 automated commits in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: **6 own commits** were made in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 10 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The changes updated `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and daily report paths, added explanatory comments to error handling in `generate-activity.mjs`, and refactored diagnosis probing to include headers in deduplication keys with a `catch` fallback. Concurrent probing was optimized to reduce duplicate requests and improve performance. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user opened issue #5584, “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”. The issue received one comment, and `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied that the cause was traced and the fix was mostly wiring around `loadHistoryUntilMessage`.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 有 6 次本人提交，另有 10 次自动提交
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **6 次本人提交**，另有 10 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。改动更新了 `.gitignore` 中针对 `.history` 和日报路径的忽略规则，在 `generate-activity.mjs` 的错误处理函数中补充注释，并重构诊断探测逻辑，为去重键加入 headers，同时增加 `catch` 兜底。并发探测逻辑得到优化，以减少重复请求并提升性能。在 `openchamber/openchamber`，用户新开了 issue #5584“[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”。该 issue 收到一条评论，`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称已定位原因，修复主要是围绕 `loadHistoryUntilMessage` 的接线工作。
